meta.description: Credential-free export. Every secret is referenced through an n8n credential name or an environment variable that must be configured on the local instance before the workflow can run. The workflow stops for human approval and can never write to main.

nodes.name: Scheduled Poll
nodes.notes: Poll only. No public webhook, no tunnel. If this machine is off the site is unaffected; the next run simply catches up.

nodes.name: Fetch GitHub Releases
nodes.notes: Attach a READ-ONLY GitHub credential in the n8n UI. No token is stored in this file.

nodes.name: Fetch Closed Pull Requests
nodes.notes: Attach the same READ-ONLY GitHub credential. No token is stored in this file.

nodes.name: Normalize Evidence
nodes.notes: Bounded evidence contract. Rejects anything the deterministic filter should already have dropped.

nodes.name: Build Gemini Prompt
nodes.notes: Loads CURRENT_PORTFOLIO_FACTS from the repository and passes GitHub text as untrusted, clearly fenced data.

nodes.name: Gemini Draft Proposal
nodes.notes: Attach a Gemini credential in the n8n UI and set PORTFOLIO_GEMINI_MODEL. No API key is stored in this file. responseMimeType is application/json so the model returns the proposal schema and nothing else. Gemini drafts only; it can never reach production.

nodes.name: Parse Structured Response
nodes.notes: Boundary between raw model output and the workflow. Rejects malformed JSON, prose, arrays, primitives, multiple objects, provider errors, truncated output, unexpected wrappers and anything over 64 KiB. No silent JSON repair. Parsing establishes syntax only: this CLI also runs the deterministic validator before it will write a proposal file.

nodes.name: Validate Proposal
nodes.notes: Deterministic gate: allowlist, protected fields, exact current-value match, evidence refs, unknown keys. A failure here ends the run. Parsing success is not authorization.

nodes.name: Create Notion Review Row
nodes.notes: Editorial review only. Field shape is documented in automation/notion/review-database.schema.json. Attach a Notion credential in the n8n UI; set PORTFOLIO_NOTION_DATABASE_ID.

nodes.name: STOP FOR HUMAN APPROVAL — Resume Poll
nodes.notes: Hard boundary. The drafting half of this workflow ends at the Notion row. Nothing downstream runs until a human has approved and an approval artifact exists.

nodes.name: Dry Run Patch
nodes.notes: Writes nothing. Prints project, fields and old/new values for the operator.

nodes.name: Apply Canonical Patch
nodes.notes: Revalidates current values immediately before writing. A drifted value aborts instead of overwriting. Touches only data/portfolio/*.json.

parameters.command: npm run data:generate && npm run generate:projects

nodes.name: Run Generators
nodes.notes: Generated files are produced here and only here. Automation never edits portfolio-data.js, projects/<slug>/index.html or sitemap.xml directly.

nodes.name: Repository QA Gate
nodes.notes: Authoritative quality gate. A non-zero exit must abort before any branch is pushed.

nodes.name: Create Draft PR Plan
nodes.notes: Emits a plan, not a PR. Branch name is sanitized to [a-z0-9-].

nodes.name: GitHub Write Gate (disabled)
nodes.notes: Draft PRs only, base main, auto-merge disabled. There is no path from this workflow to main.

nodes.name: Write PR URL To Notion
nodes.notes: Sets Status and PR URL on the existing review row, matched by Event Key.

environment_variables_required.PORTFOLIO_REPO_ROOT: Absolute path to a local checkout of this repository inside the n8n container.
environment_variables_required.PORTFOLIO_WORK_DIR: Scratch directory for event/evidence/proposal/approval artifacts. Must be outside data/portfolio/.
environment_variables_required.PORTFOLIO_GITHUB_WRITE_ENABLED: Leave unset or 'false'. Set to 'true' only when a write-scoped GitHub credential exists and draft PR creation is intended.

credentials_required.githubApi: Read scope for polling. A separate write-scoped credential is required only for draft PR creation.
